functions.name: Comparer.Equals
functions.signature: Comparer.Equals(comparer as function, x as any, y as any) as logical
functions.summary: Returns a logical value based on the equality check over the two given values.

functions.name: Comparer.FromCulture
functions.signature: Comparer.FromCulture(culture as text, optional ignoreCase as nullable logical) as function
functions.summary: Returns a comparer function based on the specified culture and case-sensitivity.

functions.name: Comparer.Ordinal
functions.signature: Comparer.Ordinal(x as any, y as any) as number
functions.summary: Returns a comparer function which uses Ordinal rules to compare values.

functions.name: Comparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase
functions.signature: Comparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase(x as any, y as any) as number
functions.summary: Returns a case-insensitive comparer function which uses Ordinal rules to compare values.
